name: Professional Money Laundering Networks
description: Specialists who launder criminal proceeds for others as a service, for a fee or commission, using networks of couriers, brokers, front companies, accounts and informal value transfer. They run structured, repeatable laundering infrastructure serving multiple criminal clients.

sources.text: FATF, Professional Money Laundering (2018); FATF and Egmont, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
Europol, European Union Serious and Organised Crime Threat Assessment (EU SOCTA) (specify 2021 or 2025)

indicators.name: Accounts serving many unrelated clients with common controller
indicators.desc: Several apparently separate businesses or sub-accounts share owners, signatories, addresses, devices or bank accounts.
indicators.ctx: Multiple accounts or companies linked to the same controllers are used for flows of different, unrelated parties.
indicators.fp: Payment agents and accountants hold client money legitimately.

indicators.name: Funds move in fixed commission-like deductions
indicators.canon: Funds move in fixed commission-like deductions
indicators.desc: Recurring small percentage retained from inbound flows consistent with fee-taking by an intermediary.
indicators.ctx: Recurring small percentage retained from inbound flows consistent with fee-taking by an intermediary.
indicators.fp: Brokers and payment agents charge fees.

indicators.name: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
indicators.canon: Mirror or offsetting transactions between jurisdictions
indicators.desc: Reciprocal or offsetting payments occur between counterparties or operators in different countries with no direct value transfer.
indicators.ctx: Payments in one country are balanced by payments elsewhere without movement of funds between them.
indicators.fp: Netting and bank-to-bank settlement may look similar.

indicators.name: Use of numerous shell companies with generic activity
indicators.canon: Newly formed entity with vague purpose and large flows
indicators.desc: Recently incorporated entity or group of entities with generic business descriptions shows significant turnover or purchases soon after formation.
indicators.ctx: Large number of newly formed companies cycle funds with vague trade descriptions.

indicators.name: Third-party payments for unrelated debts or purchases
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Payers settle obligations of others without clear relationship, often in trade or loan context.
indicators.fp: Guarantors or group treasury pay for others.

indicators.name: Links to known launderers or adverse media
indicators.canon: Adverse media or intelligence linking counterparties to criminal activity
indicators.desc: Counterparties, suppliers, respondents or controllers appear in adverse media, law-enforcement notices or intelligence connected to financial crime, abuse, forced labour or organised crime.
indicators.ctx: Counterparties or controllers appear in law-enforcement notices, adverse media or intelligence.

indicators.name: Complex use of multiple services for single flow
indicators.canon: Complex use of multiple services for single flow
indicators.desc: One flow touches cash, remitters, trade invoices, crypto and corporate accounts in a short time.
indicators.ctx: One flow touches cash, remitters, trade invoices, crypto and corporate accounts in a short time.

indicators.name: Customer lacks understanding of the transactions it executes
indicators.canon: Unable or unwilling to explain transaction purpose or origin
indicators.desc: When asked about a transaction, the customer gives vague, rehearsed, inconsistent or shifting explanations of its purpose, source or counterparties.
indicators.ctx: Controllers cannot explain commercial purpose or counterparties.

indicators.name: Frequent use of cash couriers or exchange houses alongside bank flows
indicators.canon: Frequent use of money service businesses, exchange houses or cash couriers alongside bank flows
indicators.desc: Account activity regularly blends MSB, exchange house or cash courier movements with bank transfers.
indicators.ctx: Cash movement is blended with bank transfers via associated money service businesses.
indicators.fp: MSB use is common in some communities.
